title: Analyzing Hate Speech Data along Racial, Gender and Intersectional Axes

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying tweets as African American English (AAE) or Standard American English (SAE) using a dialect classifier as a proxy for race, and comparing the distribution of hate speech/offensive annotations and BERT model predictions between these groups.

Using a fine-tuned BERT model to classify the inferred gender (masculine or feminine) of tweet authors, then evaluating disparities in neutral, offensive, and hateful annotations and subsequent model predictions across genders.

Analyzing the intersection of the inferred race (AAE/SAE) and gender (masculine/feminine) classifications to measure combined disparities in human annotations and BERT model predictions (e.g., specifically measuring bias against AAE+Masculine tweets), and evaluating the effects of balanced training data on mitigation.
